title: Resident Account Terms Exhibit: Due Day, Grace Period, Late Fee and Returned Payment Figures
content:
**Exhibit to the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.** The figures below govern the resident account at every care level. Monetary amounts are in US dollars.

| Term | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 | Level 5 | Level 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fee due day: day of the calendar month on which rent and care fees are billed in advance and fall due | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Payment grace period after the posting of the monthly charges, calendar days | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Late fee, flat amount | 85.00 | 85.00 | 85.00 | 85.00 | 85.00 | 85.00 |
| Late fee percentage, percent of the past-due amount for the billing period | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 |
| Minimum past-due amount for a late fee (below it no late fee is assessed) | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 |
| Returned payment fee, per payment returned unpaid by the bank | 40.00 | 40.00 | 40.00 | 40.00 | 40.00 | 40.00 |

### Notes

- The flat amount and the percentage are the two components of the late fee; the late fee is the greater of the two.
- The minimum past-due amount is a floor on the past-due amount, not on the fee: a past-due amount of exactly 150.00 is not below the minimum, while 149.99 is below it (hypothetical amounts).
- The grace period is counted in calendar days from the posting date of the monthly charges.
